title: Customer States and Feature Complaints
summary: This topic is dominated by brief customer-state statements and complaint-style service notes, with a smaller set of clear positives about technology, driving, and EV ownership and a few negatives describing poor overall experience or worsening unresolved problems.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's technology, driving character, and electric ownership experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe a poor ownership experience and problems that have persisted since delivery and worsened with use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly terse service-style statements about features, controls, or conditions without enough context to tell whether the customer is satisfied or dissatisfied.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined short-form service notes, which limits clear interpretation of customer sentiment.
The cluster mixes broad ownership impressions with isolated feature mentions and repair-style complaints, so the topic is only loosely coherent.
Examples are insufficient to describe specific recurring failure patterns beyond the few explicit negative fragments shown.
